reportedSiteIds.description: Resolved requested sites only. Canonical IDs are <task>/<task-relative-posix-path>:<1-based-line>:<1-based-column>; paths must begin rename/, delete/, or reach/. This field must be disjoint from unresolvedSiteIds.

unresolvedSiteIds.description: Unresolved boundaries only. Canonical IDs use task-prefixed paths and must be disjoint from reportedSiteIds.
